records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Comparable sales for stores open at least fifteen months, plus our e-commerce net sales, decreased $187.3 million, or 14.6%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in net sales was primarily driven by a 14.6% decrease in our comps, which decreased net sales by $187.3 million and our non-comparable sales, which decreased net sales by $19.6 million, driven by the net decrease of 20 stores since the second quarter of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Inventory decreased by 15.2%, or $175.8 million, from $1,159.0 million at the end of the second quarter of 2022 to $983.2 million at the end of the second quarter of 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Gross margin dollars decreased $62.6 million, while gross margin rate increased 40 basis points to 33.0% of net sales.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Operating loss rate increased 260 basis points to (10.7)%.
